settings.tab_content: Formulated with micro-milled natural iron oxides and titanium dioxides, ensuring weightless application and flawless light-diffusion.
Blended with cold-pressed organic jojoba oil and wild-harvested shea butter to naturally hydrate skin without clogging pores.
Dermatologist verified and proven hypoallergenic. Completely free from synthetic binders, artificial colorants, and heavy metals.
100% vegan formulation. Never tested on animals. Registered officially with Leaping Bunny and PETA organizations.
